name: 7 Card Stud High-Low
description: 7 Card Stud Hi-Lo: seven cards each (two down, four up, one down). Pot split between best high hand and best qualifying low (typically 8-or-better). Can scoop with best of both. USA.

rules.objective: Win the high half and/or the low half of the pot; best high hand and best qualifying low (e.g. 8-or-better) split; one player can scoop both.
rules.gameplay: Same as 7 Card Stud (two down, four up, one down; betting rounds). At showdown, best high hand and best qualifying low split the pot. Ace can count high or low for low.

strategy.basic: Play for both ways when possible; qualify low (8-or-better).
strategy.intermediate: Read board for scoop potential; fold weak one-way hands.
strategy.advanced: Third street decisions; when to chase low or high only.
tips: Pot split high and low; qualify for low (e.g. 8-or-better).

variations.name: Seven Card Stud Hi-Lo Eight or Better
variations.description: High-low split pot with an 8-or-better qualifier for low using ace-to-five lowball ranking; if no qualifying low hand, the high hand wins the entire pot.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This variant only tightens the low-hand qualifier and ranking rules; engine overrides for these parameters are not yet modeled.

variations.name: Seven Card Stud High-Low with Declare
variations.description: After the final betting round, players simultaneously declare high, low, or both (for example using chips in hand); only declared directions may win their half of the pot, and a both-declaring player must win both high and low to scoop.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This home-game variant adds a declaration step before showdown; engine overrides and UI for declaration sequencing are not yet modeled.

scoring.description: Pot split between high and low; scoop if you win both.
scoring.winCondition: Win the high half and/or the low half of the pot; best high hand and best qualifying low (e.g. 8-or-better) split; one player can scoop both.
